title: Interim Government (1946-1947)
definition: A transitional executive council formed on September 2, 1946, under the Cabinet Mission Plan to govern India during the period of transfer of power from British rule to independence.
importanceInUpsc: Critical for understanding the constitutional transition, the role of the Viceroy, the breakdown of cooperation between Congress and the Muslim League, and the prelude to Partition.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Interim Government.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
